pack.name: Kingdoms of the Long Night
pack.summary: Hardcore-survival fantasy kingdoms on NeoForge 1.21.1. Vast Tectonic/Terralith lands, medieval building, Ars Nouveau magic, and the longnight core mod that owns every person in the world.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Default preset. No shaders, no Distant Horizons. Recommended 6 GB RAM.

rich.title: Rich
rich.description: Adds Iris + Complementary Reimagined shaders, Distant Horizons and Sound Physics Remastered. Recommended 8 GB RAM and a mid/high-end GPU.

resolver: tools/pack/resolve_manifest.py (Modrinth API v2; newest release, else beta; never alpha; pins honoured)

files.title: AmbientSounds
files.reason: Biome/time/weather ambience (wind, night insects, caves) for a lonely long-night mood.

files.title: AppleSkin
files.reason: Shows hunger/saturation values: essential for a hardcore food loop.

files.title: Ars Nouveau
files.reason: The single player-facing arcane path (glyph spellcrafting, rituals). Chosen over Iron's Spells: 2 external deps (GeckoLib, Curios) vs 4 incl. a beta playerAnimator + Iron's Lib, and no humanoid NPC traders (Iron's adds Priest/Apothecarist/Wandering Magician/Pyromancer etc.).

files.title: CreativeCore
files.reason: Required library for ambientsounds.

files.title: Curios API
files.reason: Accessory-slot API required by Ars Nouveau (declared in its neoforge.mods.toml, NOT declared on Modrinth, so listed explicitly).

files.title: Distant Horizons
files.reason: Level-of-detail terrain far beyond render distance: see mountain ranges days away. Config ships a moderate quality profile.

files.title: EMI
files.reason: Recipe viewer. Chosen over JEI: release channel on 1.21.1 (JEI 1.21.1 builds are beta and now need MezzConfig), no deps; Farmer's Delight and Ars Nouveau ship EMI plugins.

files.title: Entity Culling
files.reason: Skips rendering hidden entities/block entities (helps in dense settlements).

files.title: Farmer's Delight
files.reason: Cooking, crops and preserved food: deeper hardcore food loop; official NeoForge 1.21.1 build.

files.title: FerriteCore
files.reason: Cuts memory use (blockstate/model dedup); important with 40 mods on 6 GB.

files.title: Geckolib
files.reason: Animation library required by Ars Nouveau (declared in its neoforge.mods.toml, NOT declared on Modrinth, so listed explicitly).

files.title: Handcrafted
files.reason: Rustic furniture (benches, tables, shelves, cupboards) for halls and homes.

files.title: ImmediatelyFast
files.reason: Speeds up immediate-mode rendering (HUD, text, maps, signs).

files.title: Iris Shaders
files.reason: Shader loader (works on top of Sodium).
files.pin_reason: Only Iris build for 1.21.1 NeoForge that targets Sodium 0.8 (the newest release, 1.8.12, targets Sodium 0.6 and Supplementaries declares Sodium < 0.8.12-beta.1 incompatible).

files.title: Jade 🔍
files.reason: What-am-I-looking-at tooltip (blocks, mobs, growth stages).

files.title: Lithium
files.reason: Server/game-logic optimisations (AI, physics, chunk ticking) without changing vanilla behaviour.

files.title: Lithostitched
files.reason: Required library for tectonic, terralith.

files.title: Macaw's Bridges
files.reason: Rope/log/stone bridges for roads across Tectonic rivers and gorges.

files.title: Macaw's Doors
files.reason: Wooden, barn, portcullis-style and stable doors.

files.title: Macaw's Fences and Walls
files.reason: Castle walls, palisades and hedges for settlement defences.

files.title: Macaw's Paths and Pavings
files.reason: Cobbled roads and paving between settlements.

files.title: Macaw's Windows
files.reason: Arrow slits, gothic and parapet windows, shutters.

files.title: Macaw's Roofs
files.reason: Pitched/attic/thatch-style roofs: the core of medieval silhouettes.

files.title: ModernFix
files.reason: Faster launch, lower memory, many bug fixes for modded NeoForge.

files.title: Moonlight Lib
files.reason: Required library for supplementaries.

files.title: Mouse Tweaks
files.reason: Inventory drag/scroll handling; pure client QoL.

files.title: Particle Rain
files.reason: Particle rain/snow and storm fog; cheap, strong weather atmosphere.

files.title: Resourceful Lib
files.reason: Required library for handcrafted.

files.title: Sodium
files.reason: Modern chunk renderer; the single biggest client FPS win.

files.title: Sound Physics Remastered
files.reason: Reverb/occlusion for caves and halls. Rich preset only: costs CPU and the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build is beta (1.5.x are alpha).

files.title: Supplementaries
files.reason: Medieval-feeling decor and utility (sacks, jars, signposts, flags, lanterns, hourglass, ropes). Its Red Merchant trader is disabled by our config because longnight owns all NPCs.
files.pin_reason: 4.0.0/4.0.1 were released hours ago (11 Oct 2026, new major, hotfix after 90 min); 3.9.9 is the last month-old 3.x release. Re-evaluate 4.0.x in a later pack update.

files.title: Tectonic
files.reason: Continent-scale terrain, real mountain ranges and rivers: the 'long journey' Middle-earth scale. Ships built-in Terralith compatibility.

files.title: Terralith
files.reason: ~100 vanilla-block biomes; Tectonic's documented companion (Tectonic ships the Terralith compat). Terralith's own structure sets - including 'fortified villages' full of villagers - are switched off in config/terralith.json (custom_structures=false) because longnight owns all NPCs.

files.title: Xaero's Minimap
files.reason: Minimap + waypoints for continent-scale travel (Fair-Play edition has no NeoForge 1.21.1 build).

files.title: Xaero's World Map
files.reason: Full-screen world map that pairs with the minimap.

files.title: YUNG's API
files.reason: Required library for yungs-better-dungeons, yungs-better-mineshafts, yungs-better-strongholds, yungs-better-desert-temples.

files.title: YUNG's Better Desert Temples
files.reason: Exploration: ruined temples worth raiding; no NPCs.

files.title: YUNG's Better Dungeons
files.reason: Exploration: catacombs and fortresses with loot; no NPCs.

files.title: YUNG's Better Mineshafts
files.reason: Exploration: varied, atmospheric abandoned mines; no NPCs.

files.title: YUNG's Better Strongholds
files.reason: Exploration: a real underground fortress; no NPCs.

files.title: Complementary Shaders - Reimagined
files.reason: Shader pack (Complementary License 1.7: modpack use allowed when added via Modrinth/CurseForge systems, unmodified, credited). Enabled by default in the rich preset.

rejected.name: MineColonies
rejected.reason: Adds its own colonists/NPC society; longnight owns all NPCs (decision D2). (Its official builds are on CurseForge; the Modrinth 'minecolonies' project is an old 1.18.2 upload with no NeoForge 1.21.1 build.)

rejected.name: Millénaire
rejected.reason: Adds NPC villages and cultures; longnight owns all NPCs (D2). (Also not on Modrinth for NeoForge 1.21.1.)

rejected.name: Guard Villagers
rejected.reason: Adds NPC guards; longnight owns all NPCs (D2).

rejected.name: Villager Recruits / Recruits & Workers
rejected.reason: Recruitable NPC armies; longnight owns all NPCs (D2). (No NeoForge 1.21.1 build on Modrinth either.)

rejected.name: Towns and Towers
rejected.reason: Adds villages/outposts with villager NPCs; settlements and people come from longnight (D2/D3).

rejected.name: ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village (CTOV)
rejected.reason: Village overhaul; villages are disabled and settlements come from longnight (D3).

rejected.name: Easy NPC
rejected.reason: Generic NPC framework; longnight owns all NPCs (D2).

rejected.name: Human Companions
rejected.reason: Recruitable human NPCs; longnight owns all NPCs (D2). (Not on Modrinth for NeoForge 1.21.1.)

rejected.name: Minecraft Comes Alive (MCA Reborn)
rejected.reason: Replaces villagers with a full NPC society (families, marriage); directly conflicts with longnight (D2). (Its NeoForge 1.21.1 file is a beta despite the 'release' tag.)

rejected.name: Terralith fortified villages (structure set terralith:rare_village)
rejected.reason: Terralith itself is kept, but it ships fortified villages full of villagers. The pack disables Terralith's custom structures (config/terralith.json custom_structures=false) until longnight overrides data/terralith/worldgen/structure_set/rare_village.json itself; see VERIFICATION.md.

rejected.name: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
rejected.reason: Magic: only one magic mod; Ars Nouveau chosen (fewer/lighter deps, no beta deps, no humanoid NPC traders such as Priest/Apothecarist/Wandering Magician).

rejected.name: IceAndFire Community Edition
rejected.reason: Exists for NeoForge 1.21.1 (2.0 release 18 Jul 2026; 2.1-beta.1 the same day) and a side boot test of it passed (fresh world + structure probe; it needs Architectury, which its library Uranus requires but Modrinth does not declare). Still not 'clearly stable' for a long hardcore world: brand-new major line whose own page warns that swapping versions corrupts saves, heavy world-gen (roosts, caves, graveyards), terrain-griefing dragons and 3 extra libraries. Decision for v0.1: no dragon mod - longnight will provide dragons later.

rejected.name: Dragon Mounts Remastered
rejected.reason: Available (1.9.2) but PolyForm-Noncommercial, last update Sep 2025, tame-a-pet-dragon design rather than world threat; longnight will provide dragons later.

rejected.name: Ice and Fire (original)
rejected.reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 version on Modrinth.

rejected.name: Noisium
rejected.reason: Last NeoForge 1.21.1 build Aug 2024 (project no longer actively updated for this branch) and it patches noise generation that Tectonic also reshapes; not worth the world-gen risk.

rejected.name: C2ME (NeoForge)
rejected.reason: Only alpha builds for NeoForge 1.21.1.

rejected.name: Visuality
rejected.reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 version on Modrinth.

rejected.name: Falling Leaves
rejected.reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 version on Modrinth. (A different 'falling-leaves' project exists: All-Rights-Reserved, ~8k downloads, unknown author - not trusted.)

rejected.name: JEI
rejected.reason: EMI chosen instead (JEI's NeoForge 1.21.1 builds are beta and now require MezzConfig).

rejected.name: JourneyMap
rejected.reason: Xaero's Minimap + World Map chosen instead (lighter, vanilla look).

rejected.name: Xaero's Minimap (Fair-Play)
rejected.reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 build on Modrinth; full edition used.

rejected.name: Controlling + Searchables
rejected.reason: Optional keybind-search QoL; cut to keep the pack at <=40 mods.

rejected.name: Macaw's Furniture
rejected.reason: Handcrafted chosen for furniture (more rustic); one furniture mod is enough.

rejected.name: Complementary Unbound / BSL / Bliss
rejected.reason: One shader is enough: BSL and Bliss are All-Rights-Reserved with no explicit modpack grant; Complementary Reimagined has an explicit modpack grant and is lighter than Unbound.
